name: KSE
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
KSE test as formula.
    </description>
    <rule name="KSE" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="dx">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="timestep">
        0.01
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="1">
            float4 gradient_mag_squared = pow( x_gradient_a, 2.0f ) + pow( y_gradient_a, 2.0f );
			
			float lapweight = -1.0f;
            float bilapweight = -1.0f;
            float gms_weight = 0.2f;
            delta_a = bilapweight * bilaplacian_a + lapweight * laplacian_a + ( gradient_mag_squared ) * gms_weight;
        
            // Sugestion from Steffen Richters which worked: Subtract tiny amount of reagent.
            // to stabilize the range:
            float stabilize = -0.05f;
            delta_a += a * stabilize;
            a_out[index_here] = a + timestep * delta_a;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
       <white_noise low="0.6" high="0.7001">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>

      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">

      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">

      <contour_level value="0.25">
